name: Grafana Cloud
description: Grafana Cloud lets agents search dashboards, query metrics and logs, and read alerts and incidents in the signed-in Grafana Cloud stack. The user needs the Cloud MCP User role and signs in through the browser.

prompts.text: Which alerts are firing right now and since when?
Show the error logs for the checkout service from the last hour.
Find the dashboard for API latency and summarize the last 24 hours.

apps.name: Grafana Cloud
apps.description: Dashboard, metric, log, and alert access, over Grafana Labs' MCP server with browser sign-in.
